notes: «زرعة بن محمد عن سماعة وعن المفضل بن عمر عن أبي عبد الله»: the text gives «سماعة» and «المفضل بن عمر» after «زرعة» with «و» and only «المفضل» is followed by the Imam; they are read as alternatives in one level, but whether سماعة leads to the Imam or stands as a separate route is not written, so this needs a ruling
«عدة من أصحابنا» is an unnamed link; the number «3ـ» is stripped
the second statement, the Imam's words about علي بن الحسين, is the matn
